Job description

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

Executar atividades relacionadas ao fornecimento e orientações técnicas sobre medicamentos aos usuários e atuação junto às equipes de saúde da família, promovendo o uso racional de medicamentos.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Farmácia;
  • Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Farmácia Clínica, Atenção Farmacêutica ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses comprovada na função.

Additional information

Local de atuação: AP 4.0 (Jacarepaguá, Barra, Recreio e Vargens)

Carga Horária: 40h semanais

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

  • Reportar periodicamente à Superintendência o status da segurança, principais riscos e indicadores de desempenho.

  • Experiência comprovada em:
  • Segurança da Informação: gestão de vulnerabilidades, SNOC, IAM, políticas, auditorias.
  • Infraestrutura de TI: administração de servidores (Windows/Linux), redes, storage, gestão de ambientes críticos.
  • Resiliência Operacional: continuidade de negócios, backup, DRP.
  • Vivência em empresas de energia ou setores críticos será diferencial.

title: Host City Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)
description:
Position

The Host City Manager will be responsible for the institutional management of FIFA's relationship with the state and municipal governments of the respective Host City of the FIFA Women's World Cup TM.

Acting as the main local liaison, this professional will ensure the monitoring and coordination of government commitments under their responsibility, ensuring continuous alignment with FIFA's strategy and guidelines.

The position is preferably based in the Host City itself, ensuring local presence, institutional proximity, and direct monitoring of agendas.

The Manager will report directly to the Head of Government Relations and Host Cities.

Host Cities

  • Belo Horizonte
  • Brasília
  • Fortaleza
  • Porto Alegre
  • Recife
  • Rio de Janeiro
  • Salvador
  • São Paulo

Please apply only if you currently live in one of these cities or can relocate there independently.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Institutional Relations with State and Municipal Governments

    Act as FIFA's main institutional representative to the State Government and City Hall of the Host City under your responsibility.

    Maintain ongoing relationships with state and municipal secretariats, autonomous agencies, public companies, and other relevant local bodies.

    Ensure that local authorities are aligned with the commitments made in the Host City Agreement and other instruments signed with FIFA.

  2. Monitoring of Government Deliverables

    Monitor and report on the status of state and municipal government obligations related to the tournament.

    Identify risks, bottlenecks, and schedule deviations, proposing solutions and making the necessary adjustments.

    Support, when applicable, the local coordination of thematic working groups (security, transportation, mobility, public services, among others).

  3. Coordination with FIFA's Central Structure

    Act as a link between the Host City and FIFA's functional areas (Security, Transportation, Operations, Sustainability, Communications, among others).

    Ensure that local information and demands are reported in a structured and timely manner to the Head of the area.

    Support the organization of technical visits, workshops, meetings, and official FIFA agendas in the Host City.

  4. Planning, Reporting, and Governance

    Prepare periodic reports on institutional relations and the status of the Host City's commitments.

    Update reports, schedules, and monitoring tools defined by the Government Relations area.

    Ensure institutional consistency, alignment of discourse, and adherence to FIFA guidelines at the local level.

  5. Reporting and Governance

    Coordinated action with other Host City Managers, ensuring standardization and an integrated vision of the project.

Your Profile

Education

Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Law, Public Administration, Communication, Political Science, or related fields.

Experience

Solid experience of at least 6 years in government relations, institutional coordination, or public stakeholder management, preferably in complex projects, large-scale events, or institutional environments.

Previous experience in large sport events or organizations with an international interface (FIFA, Local Organizing Committees, IOC, etc.).

Behavioral Competencies

  • Organization and method: Ability to structure processes, prioritize demands, and perform tasks efficiently.
  • Proactivity: Anticipation of management and head needs, with a focus on solutions.
  • Attention to detail: Rigorous with quality, consistency of information, and meeting deadlines.
  • Institutional communication: Clear oral and written communication, with tone and language appropriate to the institutional environment.

Differentials

  • Familiarity with management and collaboration tools (SharePoint, Teams, Google Drive, WeTrack, or similar)

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Based in one of the listed cities (Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Porto Alegre, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador & São Paulo) or able to relocate there independently.

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at FIFA Women's World CupTM by 2x.

title: Manager, Volunteer System FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The positon

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

Key responsibilities

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑the‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

Your profile

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

description:
Especialista em TI - Cientista / Arquiteto de Inteligência Artificial (IA)

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Estamos buscando um Cientista / Arquiteto de IA para liderar tecnicamente nossas iniciativas de Inteligência Artificial e atuar como referência na definição de modelos, arquitetura, padrões e boas práticas. Este profissional será responsável por transformar problemas de negócio em soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alto impacto, além de orientar o time no desenvolvimento de agentes de IA, modelos de machine learning e aplicações avançadas baseadas em dados.

É uma posição estratégica, com grande visibilidade e impacto direto na evolução digital da companhia.

A nossa empresa é feita por gente. Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia.

Traga a sua energia para a Light !

Seus desafios serão:

  • Definir a arquitetura de soluções de IA, incluindo frameworks, modelos, pipelines e tecnologias recomendadas.
  • Liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento de modelos de Machine Learning, NLP, LLMs e agentes autônomos.
  • Traduzir desafios de negócio em problemas científicos claros e solucionáveis com IA.
  • Conduzir experimentação, criação de protótipos e avaliações técnicas de modelos.
  • Estabelecer padrões, boas práticas, segurança e governança para uso de IA na empresa.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com engenheiros de dados, MLOps, backend e demais papéis para garantir que modelos escalem em produção.
  • Avaliar novas tecnologias, papers, arquiteturas e abordagens do mercado, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Atuar como referência técnica do time, orientando decisões e garantindo qualidade das entregas.

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em áreas de TI.
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento e arquitetura de modelos de IA.
  • Domínio de técnicas de Machine Learning, Deep Learning e NLP.
  • Conhecimento em modelos LLMs (open‑source e proprietários), RAG, embeddings e ferramentas avançadas de IA generativa.
  • Experiência com Python e frameworks como TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit‑Learn, HuggingFace, LangChain ou equivalentes.
  • Entendimento de boas práticas de engenharia (versionamento, testes, pipelines, CI/CD).
  • Experiência com cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure) e ambientes com GPU.
  • Conhecimento de arquiteturas modernas para agentes inteligentes e automação baseada em IA.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com otimização de modelos (quantização, LoRA, fine‑tuning).
  • Vivência com plataformas de MLOps (Kubeflow, MLflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker).
  • Publicações, participação em conferências ou contribuições em projetos open‑source.
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de grande escala.

O que temos para você:

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Auxilio Farmáciaç
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras;
  • Programa de treinamentos.

Há mais de 120 anos, fazemos parte da história e do dia a dia de milhões de pessoas no Rio de Janeiro. Mais do que uma empresa de energia, somos uma potência em movimento. Estamos presentes em 31 municípios, levando energia para mais de 4 milhões de clientes e conectando mais de 11 milhões de vidas com qualidade, confiabilidade e propósito.

O que nos move vai além da eletricidade: é a vontade de fazer diferente, de criar soluções sustentáveis, de colocar o cliente no centro e de transformar realidades, sempre com ética, simplicidade, inteligência de dados e, acima de tudo, com gente boa.

Nosso compromisso é contribuir para o bem‑estar da sociedade e liderar a transformação do setor elétrico com responsabilidade, inovação e eficiência.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza novas ideias. Onde resultados são reconhecidos, os desafios são grandes e o aprendizado é ainda maior. Acreditamos em pessoas inquietas, que pensam como donas, que buscam sempre o melhor e têm coragem para inovar em um setor em plena evolução.

Queremos ser referência em confiança e sustentabilidade até 2029 e sabemos que isso começa pelas pessoas que escolhem crescer com a gente.

Na Light, cada talento que chega carrega o potencial de iluminar o futuro. Venha fazer parte dessa história.

Automação e CI/CD

Observabilidade e Monitoramento

Sobre o Grupo Profarma:

Fundado em 1961 com a criação da Profarma Distribuição, o Grupo Profarma consolidou-se como um dos líderes no mercado farmacêutico brasileiro, ocupando hoje uma relevante atuação no mercado nacional em distribuição. Em 2013, ampliamos nossa atuação para o varejo farmacêutico por meio da Rede d1000, composta por mais de 270 lojas sob as bandeiras Drogasmil, Farmalife, Drogarias Tamoio e Drogaria Rosário.

title: Senior Manager, Transport Finance
description:
About The Global Covenant of Mayors For Climate & Energy

The Global Covenant of Mayors for Climate and Energy (GCoM or Global Covenant), is a global coalition of cities and local governments with a shared long‑term vision of promoting and supporting voluntary action to combat climate change and move to a low‑carbon, resilient society. The alliance unites and inspires its stakeholders to strengthen global climate coherence, accelerate the energy transition, and generate locally‑tailored solutions for a common purpose: creating an inclusive, just, low‑emission, and climate‑resilient future for all.

Co‑chaired by former New York City Mayor and UN Secretary‑General’s Special Envoy for Climate Ambition and Solutions, Michael R. Bloomberg, and European Commission Executive Vice‑President for the European Green Deal, Frans Timmermans, and with the support of global and regional city networks, the Global Covenant of Mayors represents the strongest and clearest signal to national governments that cities are not only acting to stop the effects of climate change, they are leading and leading together. Mayors from across all global regions serve on the Board, and represent city networks, Regional Covenants and bring locally specific perspectives – ensuring that the Global Covenant of Mayors for Climate & Energy is truly led by mayors.

C40 Cities is the fiscal sponsor of the Bloomberg Philanthropies funded parts of the Global Covenant of Mayors (GCoM). As the host organization, C40 provides financial, administrative, and operational services to GCoM. C40 and GCoM are working closely together on aligned programmes and areas of activity.

The City Finance Programme

C40’s City Finance Programme works to address a range of municipal climate finance challenges, at different stages of project maturity, and across major urban infrastructure groups: clean energy, zero‑carbon buildings, transportation, waste and climate adaptation & resilience. By scaling up investment in these areas, and simultaneously divesting from fossil fuels, mayors are creating safer, healthier and more economically sustainable communities for the current and future residents of their cities. The team’s strategic focus is on strengthening city financial capacity, increasing the supply of climate finance and funding available to cities, facilitating engagement with finance providers, and building enabling environments that support urban climate investment. The core City Finance Programme team oversees and/or coordinates with special projects and initiatives within C40 that also have a finance focus, including ZEBRA, Laneshift, C40 Cities Finance Facility, UrbanShift, Climate Budgeting Pilot Project, and others.

The City Finance Programme’s transportation finance portfolio emphasises clean bus and freight technologies, and is expanding to additional strategic areas including walking & cycling, public transport improvement, clean air zones, vehicle charging infrastructure, and others.

C40 and GCoM Joint Activities

Bloomberg Philanthropies is supporting joint activities by C40 and the Global Covenant of Mayors (GCoM) to work with partners on a shared agenda to:

  • Increase cities’ access to finance for projects that combat the climate crisis and improve resilience;
  • Ensure nation‑states upgrade their national climate commitments as a result of working with cities, with a particular focus on city climate action being included in nation‑states’ climate action plans, which are due in 2025 (Nationally Determined Contributions or NDCs);
  • Improve the quality and ease of access to climate data so cities can start implementing the most impactful climate actions as quickly as possible.

Position Description:

The Senior Manager for Transportation Finance will hold primary responsibility for the transport finance portfolio, supporting C40 and GCoM cities in developing business models and financing options for zero emission transportation solutions. C40’s current transportation finance portfolio emphasises clean bus and freight technologies, but has potential to expand to additional strategic areas including clean air, walking & cycling, public transport improvement, vehicle charging infrastructure, transport resilience and others. With an expanding team, the position offers the opportunity to continue the development of a strong global workstream as well as provide strategic input into maximising city engagement and outcomes in a key sector for climate mitigation. The position requires a strong programme manager with technical skills related to clean transportation finance, as well as the ability to work collaboratively with C40 and GCoM programmes, donors, and partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead major areas of the Clean Transportation Finance global portfolio to support implementation of the zero emission urban transport agenda.
  • Lead a range of capacity building and city‑to‑city peer support activities to strengthen city capacity to attract and utilise funding/finance for transportation.
  • Develop and manage partnerships aimed at increasing the supply of finance available to cities, including through development of financial innovations.
  • Develop and implement existing and new strategic projects including developing project/fundraising proposals and implementation strategies.
  • Work with C40’s Transportation Team, Regional Teams and relevant GCoM teams, as well as directly with cities and transport authorities to identify and address challenges.
  • Independently manage budgets and key deliverables, including data and content for written reports, defining technical assistance support, and overseeing consultants.

Person Specification:

  • Substantial work experience related to finance and the transportation sector, with an emphasis on city finance desirable.
  • Experience working with municipalities on sustainable transport projects;
  • Diploma in Finance, Public Policy, Urban Planning, Engineering, Climate Policy, International Relations, Economy, or related fields.
  • Demonstrable project management experience, including oversight of multiple concurrent projects.
  • Strong strategic thinking capabilities coupled with an outcome, delivery‑orientated approach.
  • Strong abilities to work with others, both as a facilitator and an agenda driver with a highly collaborative approach to problem solving.
  • Experience with business case development, financial modelling and/or quantitative analysis of transportation issues desirable.
  • Ability to communicate complex content in a compelling manner, coupled with excellent convening and facilitation skills.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written), proficiency in other languages desirable.

Other Requirements:

Applicants must already have the right to work in the location they're applying for. Travel may be required as a part of the role.

We seek to recruit individuals who not only have the appropriate skills and experience for the role, but are committed to carrying out their roles in line with our organisational values.

Reporting To: Director, City Finance Programme

Term: Fixed Term Contract – until 31st December 2027 (the appointment and the duration of the role are subject to the final approval of funding)

Location: Brazil & South Africa – Please note that if your right to work in one of the listed locations is not confirmed at the time of applying, C40 will be unable to proceed with your application.

Salary : (Grade 3) Brazil (IC) USD 78,740 & South Africa ZAR 1,067,386 gross per annum – Due to its commitment to maintain equity and fairness, C40 operates on a spot salary model. This means that our employees are paid the same salary according to their grade and location.

Application Process:

Interested applicants should submit a curriculum vitae and cover letter. The closing date for receipt of applications is Wednesday, 7th January 2026 at 5pm GMT. C40 reserves the right to close this job opening before the closing date for applications so please do submit applications early.

title: Chief Executive Officer
description:
Join to apply for the Chief Executive Officer role at Inside Higher Ed .

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Purpose of Job

The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Howard University (HU) Faculty Practice Plan (FPP) has responsibility for the achievement of the strategic, operational, and financial goals of HU FPP. This position is responsible for the day‑to‑day operations and execution of the strategic vision for the HU FPP, including overseeing and directing organizational and physician alignment, operating and financial efficiency of clinical enterprises, practice management, revenue cycle services, expansion of referral sources, information technology and electronic health record management implementation, managed care contracting, and marketing and public relations.

This position is responsible for ensuring that high quality, innovative, and financially sustainable operations are in place and effectively managed to support HU FPP. The CEO of HU FPP will help to ensure that HU FPP is well‑positioned in a rapidly evolving and competitive environment through optimized and systematic physician practice management. Additionally, in conjunction with the management team, this position will lead efforts to collaborate with community healthcare providers to enhance patient access in the communities served by HU FPP.

Job Responsibilities

  • Profit and Loss (P&L) responsibility for the operations of HU FPP, including all aspects of effective operational and financial management and reporting, managed care contracting, and operational and capital budgeting
  • Implement operational processes and drive efficiencies at HU FPP to reduce administrative burden for HU FPP physicians
  • Develop and implement key initiatives to improve deficiencies ascertained through the evaluation of operations
  • Collaborate with Physician Enterprise leadership to apply effective processes, practice management tools, and best practices to the management of HU FPP
  • Evaluate the organizational structure for HU FPP, identifying the core competencies for each organizational unit, and effectively designing the relationships between organizational units to drive effective governance
  • Identify organizational goals, establish baseline metrics, development of key performance indicators, and standardize processes, and monitoring of performance against goals, including those related to patient satisfaction, physician engagement and satisfaction, employee engagement, patient access, clinical excellence and patient safety, efficiency and effectiveness and financial performance
  • Create and maintain a culture of accountability and serve as a resource for attaining performance metrics in all areas of the HU FPP
  • Implement Adventist HealthCare standard management approach across all departments at HU FPP
  • Work with Adventist HealthCare and HU for the development of the strategic vision for HU FPP and execution of strategic initiatives
  • Effective communication of the mission, vision, values, and strategic vision of HU FPP to internal and external stakeholders
  • Closely collaborate with the Chief Medical Officer to drive achieving mutual goals and cultivating long‑term, collaborative relationships with HU FPP physicians
  • Evaluate strategic partnership opportunities with community‑based organizations, payors, and other community stakeholders
  • Identify new opportunities in population health and with alternative payment models
  • Ability to work collaboratively with Chairs, Leadership and departmental Administrators, Physicians and Staff from diverse background and perspectives, across clinical and academic missions of an academic medical center to ensure efficient, effective clinic operations, while creating an environment conducive to engagement and satisfaction among physicians, other practitioners, and clinical staff

Required Qualifications: Competencies

Knowledge

Basic Function

This position serves as the Chief Compliance Officer, overseeing the university’s compliance program, that promotes honesty, integrity and adherence to internal policies and external regulatory requirements. The Chief Compliance Officer requires extensive experience in Compliance to effectively promote a culture of integrity, advise leadership and navigate complex University operations.

The institutional Compliance Program reinforces the University’s commitment to meeting the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and responsibility, providing independent and objective oversight of the University's compliance program to ensure that the University is compliant with all federal, state, and local laws and regulations as well as University policies.

The Chief Compliance Officer will report directly to Howard University’s Office of President and to the Board of Trustees.

The Chief Compliance Officer will have direct supervisory oversight of the Compliance divisions across the enterprise to include Howard University, Howard University Health Sciences and Howard University Hospital.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

title: College Research Administration Manager
description:
Join Howard University as a College Research Administration Manager – a hybrid reporting role pivotal to advancing the university’s R1 research mission. You’ll oversee research administration activities within assigned colleges, ensuring compliance, enhancing research productivity, and maintaining efficient workflows.

What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant organization culture

Basic Function

The College Research Administration Manager will handle pre‑ and post‑award responsibilities, collaborating with the Office of Research, college leadership, Principal Investigators (PIs), and other stakeholders.

Nature And Scope

Serve as the primary point of contact for all assigned departments within the college for pre‑award and post‑award support. Primary reporting to the Office of Research with a dotted‑line reporting relationship to the Associate Dean for Research.

Principal Accountabilities

Pre‑Award Management

  • Guide PIs in preparing and submitting grant proposals, including budgets, narratives, and compliance documentation.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for grant submissions to central research offices and funding agencies.
  • Review and approve proposals for adherence to university, federal, and sponsor guidelines.

Post‑Award Management

  • Oversee grant account setups, cost distributions, and personnel appointments on awarded projects.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, local, and university policies regarding allowable costs, effort reporting, and project amendments.
  • Monitor project budgets and expenditures, providing timely financial reports and projections.

Compliance and Reporting

  • Facilitate the preparation and submission of internal and external reports, including progress, compliance, and financial reports.
  • Collaborate with university compliance offices to address regulatory requirements and audit findings.

Training and Development

  • Conduct training sessions for PIs, departmental staff, and other stakeholders on research administration policies and systems.
  • Participate in university‑wide discussions on process improvement and best practices in research administration.

Collaboration and Oversight

  • Work with the Associate Dean for Research to align daily operations with college priorities.
  • Maintain active collaboration with the Office of Research to ensure consistent training, compliance, and professional development across colleges.
  • Act as a resource for faculty and staff in navigating research administration challenges.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in effective multitasking in a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven environment with a high degree of accuracy and organization.
  • Strong organizational and time‑management skills with exceptional attention to detail; ability to thrive in a busy, high‑volume, and deadline‑driven work team environment that requires coordination of multiple activities.
  • Excellent communication skills, including conveying complex concepts to non‑specialist audiences and serving as liaisons between granting agencies, university administration, and principal investigators.

Minimum Requirements

  • BA, BBA, or BS in Business, Finance, Accounting, or related fields and 5 years of professional experience in research administration.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Advanced knowledge of federal, state, and local regulations governing sponsored research, including Uniform Guidance and FAR clauses.
  • Excellent communication skills, including conveying complex concepts to non‑specialist audiences.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross‑functional, fast‑paced environment.
  • Proficiency in research administration systems (e.g., Cayuse, Workday).

Note: This position description is not a contract for employment. The university reserves the right to revise this position description at any time.

description:
Subsurface Data Management Specialist - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Join Aramco as a Subsurface Data Management Specialist and relocate permanently to Saudi Arabia with a full-time expatriate family relocation package.

Overview

We are seeking a Subsurface Data Management Specialist to join the Unconventional Resources Data Management & Digital Solutions Division (URDM & DSD) within the Unconventional Resources (UR) organization. URDM & DSD provides daily data support to all business departments and entities under the Unconventional Resources admin area, underpinning business continuity and operational activities crucial to the organization. The division offers services such as data governance and compliance, data discovery, preparation, validation, and packaging, as well as managing and supporting data in corporate repositories. It also oversees data quality management, synchronizes data from the corporate repository to application databases, handles legacy data cleanup and archiving, and facilitates the delivery and packaging of data to external partners.

Your primary role is to proactively manage and protect UR subsurface data (Petroleum Engineering and Geoscience) in official repositories by following corporate guidelines and industry best practices to positively impact UR business performance and mitigate risks. You will also ensure the accuracy, integrity, and accessibility of UR subsurface data, working closely with stakeholders to identify and address data-related issues and opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership and expertise in data management to support UR Subsurface operations.
  • Assess and implement technical data strategies that govern UR Subsurface data and establish clear guidelines to ensure data security, quality, and accessibility throughout its lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with corporate stakeholders to gather user requirements and recommend data management solutions, participating in data modeling design, project scoping, and specifications, as well as testing and acceptance.
  • Ensure that comprehensive metadata standards, business rules, and clear roles and responsibilities are consistently maintained and updated across all UR data domains.
  • Develop and propose data-related policies, oversee their implementation once approved, and identify and manage risks associated with sensitive information.
  • Lead complex data management projects, provide central direction and oversight, and coordinate with cross-functional teams to implement solutions, track progress, and generate performance reports.
  • Provide guidance on data quality assurance and control, driving initiatives to enhance data integrity and usability.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the current data management environment, develop and implement effective solutions, and create informative reports that include in-depth analysis and visualizations to support data‑driven decision making.
  • Mentor and develop the skills of young professional team members, sharing knowledge and expertise to upskill them in Data Management best practices and processes, and foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT. An advanced degree is highly preferred.
  • 12‑15 years of experience in the oil and gas industry, including at least 10 years focused on upstream subsurface data management. Experience in IT project management is highly preferred.
  • Strong computer and database skills, including proficiency in SQL, and extensive experience with oil and gas applications and enterprise systems.
  • High level of knowledge in upstream domain data, including unconventional resources, and ability to develop and apply cross‑disciplinary processes that support data management best practice.
  • Ability to work in a fast‑paced environment and prioritize multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
  • Professional data management certification (e.g., CDMP) is highly desirable.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry, one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhancing Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generational view of the future, born of our nine decades of experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. Our responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector‑specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

title: Manager, Volunteer Communication and Engagement
description:
Manager, Volunteer Engagement

Department: Workforce, People & Culture

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Communications & Engagement Manager will play a central role in shaping, delivering, and elevating the end-to-end communications and engagement strategy for the FIFA Volunteer Programme across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to oversee the development, coordination, and execution of all volunteer-related communications and engagement initiatives. This includes creating and implementing the overall communications plan, leading launch and promotional campaigns, managing key milestones, and delivering a structured and aligned content plan across both internal and external channels to ensure consistent and impactful communication. The successful candidate will also drive the engagement strategy covering activations such as the trophy tour, ambassador participation, mascot appearances, and partner-related activities to further build motivation, visibility, and community among volunteers.

This role will collaborate closely with the Volunteer Management team in FIFA Zurich, eight Host Cities in Brazil, the Brand and Marketing teams, external agencies, and other Functional Areas to ensure consistent, high‑quality messaging and impactful engagement touchpoints throughout the volunteer journey. This will include all touch points from launch to internal communication to volunteers.

We are seeking an experienced communications professional with a proven track record in managing complex, large‑scale communications campaigns for events and in designing informative, motivating, and culturally relevant engagement initiatives to lead the Volunteer Programme communications for diverse volunteer audiences (local and international) from the application phase through tournament‑time. The ideal candidate understands mindset of volunteer, can translate local context into global communications frameworks, has experience in large‑scale event delivery and thrives in a dynamic, multicultural environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the development and implementation of the FWWC27 Volunteer Communications & Engagement Strategy including the initial launch of the volunteer programme,
  • Ensure alignment with FIFA Women's World Cup strategy, FIFA’s global volunteer communications and engagement strategy, brand guidelines, and tournament timelines
  • Act as the primary liaison with FIFA Zurich, FIFA 27, Host Cities, and external agencies on topics related to communications and engagement.
  • Deliver key communication and engagement milestones from planning, recruitment through to tournament‑time and post‑event legacy.
  • Co‑lead communications related to the volunteer launch campaign, including messaging, creative briefs, KPIs, and rollout.
  • Draft and prepare engaging written, visual and digital content (in English and Portuguese) throughout the full journey for the volunteer platform, website, social media, FAQs, newsletters, volunteer support channel and operational communications.Right to work in Brazil.
  • Identify opportunities to highlight the Volunteer Programme via Media and Public Relations support.
  • Coordinate and integrate Host Country communications and messaging into a unified, coherent strategy that reflects the tournament's values, brand, and legacy objectives.
  • Provide Host Cities with communication toolkits, guidelines, and templates.
  • Ensure messaging consistency, accuracy, cultural relevance and crisis communication when required.
  • Ensure all internal and external messaging supports programme goals, celebrates volunteer contributions, and strengthens volunteer satisfaction and retention.
  • Oversee end‑to‑end planning and delivery of assigned communications projects, ensuring alignment between internal teams, host cities, external agencies, and other key partners.
  • Manage external stakeholders and agencies, defining requirements, providing clear briefs, aligning expectations, and ensuring an efficient end‑to‑end RFP process.
  • Lead development and execution of volunteer engagement initiatives including but not limited to trophy tour activations, ambassador and mascot appearances, partner‑related activities and tournament time engagement activities in volunteer centres.
  • Prepare and deliver communication and engagement how‑to materials, for FIFA27 and Host City team members to understand how to deliver communication and engagement deliverables.
  • Act as the liaison with Marketing, Brand & Communications teams to ensure consistency in brand, messaging, and tone, while providing cross‑functional support to other divisions including Digital, Media Relations, Content Production, and Event Communications.
  • Track and report performance of communications campaigns, content reach, engagement levels, and activation impact.
  • Provide regular updates to the Senior Volunteer Manager and FIFA27 top management and work closely with the FIFA Zurich team to ensure alignment with the global FIFA Volunteer Programme strategy.
  • Capture lessons learned and feed them into continuous improvement for future events.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 5+ years of communications experience, preferably within major events or large‑scale volunteer programmes.
  • University degree in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, Business or related field.
  • Masters in Sports Management or Event Management is an asset.
  • Proven experience in delivering FIFA tournaments, major sports events or other international events is advantageous.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to craft clear, engaging messages.
  • Creative thinking with a keen sense for storytelling and brand innovation.
  • Proven expertise in content creation, social media strategy, and media relations.
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems and related IT tools is a plus.
  • Strong project management skills with experience delivering campaigns or large‑scale communication plans.
  • Comfortable working with creative tools and platforms (e.g., Adobe Suite, CMS/web design platforms, Photoshop, Final Cut Pro, Audacity. Additional qualification in web design or animation is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate across departments and manage relationships with diverse stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success in delivering audience engagement strategies and activation events.
  • Experience working in multicultural environments; knowledge of Brazil/South America sport and cultural ecosystem is an advantage.
  • Positive, collaborative, solutions‑driven mindset; able to work autonomously and under tight timelines.
  • Team‑oriented and passion for volunteerism, community engagement, diversity, inclusion, and gender empowerment.
  • Experience working with culturally diverse teams across multiple locations/time zones.
  • Understanding of volunteer motivation and behaviour across different cultural contexts.
  • Budget Management and oversee service provider deliverables
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

  • Extensive Customer support experience is key:
    • Customer needs are top priority.

Benefits

  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Analista Administrativo Júnior
description:
Por que trabalhar conosco?

Porque somos a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão em prática fazendo a diferença nos 178 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 26 milhões de pessoas. Somos inspirados a transformar o futuro e melhorar a forma que as pessoas vivem. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

A partir de 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver atividades com orientações frequentes;

  • Manter atualizados controles administrativos de sua área de atuação, desenvolvendo estudos e efetuando levantamentos, análises, programações, conferências e cálculos na realização de atividades administrativas;

A Supergasbras é uma empresa do grupo holandês SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de Gás liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP), com mais de 100 anos de experiência. Nosso negócio é levar energia limpa e eficiente para milhões de brasileiros, seja nas suas casas, comércios, indústrias ou agronegócio. Os mais de 76 anos de atuação no Brasil nos posiciona como uma das principais distribuidoras nacionais de GLP – comercializamos cerca de 1,5 milhão de toneladas do produto por ano com aproximadamente 20% de participação de mercado.

Nossa estratégia é conseguir através da confiança e integridade, ser a melhor empresa de Energia do Brasil para nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e acionistas, com responsabilidade socioambiental.

Diversidade e inclusão é uma prioridade de negócios para a Supergasbras. Valorizamos e acreditamos no desenvolvimento de pessoas, tanto no contexto profissional como pessoal, tendo como estratégia a equidade de gênero, inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, respeito a todas as orientações sexuais e luta contra a discriminação racial nas diferentes camadas da sociedade.

A posição existe para garantir o desenvolvimento e a manutenção de aplicativos móveis híbridos modernos, responsivos e de alta performance utilizando React Native de forma consistente e otimizada, garantindo a escalabilidade, a manutenção do código e a integração fluida com outros sistemas e serviços.

  • Utilizar ferramentas modernas como Eslint, Prettier, Redux, Webpack, Mocha e Jest para garantir padronização, manutenibilidade e testabilidade do código;
  • Aplicar conhecimentos em componentização e reutilização de código para melhorar a produtividade e escalabilidade;

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Familiaridade com práticas de desenvolvimento ágil;

O grupo produz energia hidrelétrica, energia eólica, energia solar, energia a gás e fornece aquecimento urbano.

No Brasil a empresa tem sua sede localizada na cidade de Florianópolis, em Santa Catarina (SC). Atualmente, controla 26 ativos de geração renovável no Brasil. Dessa forma, a empresa tornou-se uma das maiores geradoras de energia eólica do Brasil, ultrapassando a marca de 2.2 GW de capacidade instalada, entre aquisições, construções e operações no país.

A empresa é pioneira em oferecer energia renovável rastreável com garantia de origem no Brasil, certificando, por meio do I-REC (Certificado Internacional de Energia Renovável), a origem da produção de sua energia, o que garante que a operação é sustentável.

Responsável por implementar e acompanhar processos de RH nas áreas sob sua Diretoria/Vice-Presidência, incluindo Arquitetura Organizacional, Performance & Sucessão, Comitês de Talentos, Remuneração e Benefícios, Pesquisas de Engajamento, Treinamento e Programas de Desenvolvimento.   • Elaborar relatórios e books gerenciais com dados estratégicos para suporte à tomada de decisão das lideranças;

Graduação em Psicologia,AdministraçãoouEngenharias;

Pósgraduaçãoem áreascorrelatas ;

Sólida experiênciaem RH e seus subsistemas;

Português Brasileiroe Inglês fluentes;

Experiência no setor de energia elétricae comercializadoras.

Conosco, você desenvolverá uma trajetória profissional com oportunidades incríveis. Isso inclui:

É contribuir para um planeta mais verde e sustentável. Ser Statkraft é renovar a energia que impulsiona o mundo: uma energia limpa, inspiradora, com ética, integridade e segurança.

Fazer parte da Statkraft é inspirar pessoas a escrever a nossa história, com acolhimento e respeito à diversidade em toda a sua plenitude.

Ser parte da Statkraft é vivenciar os nossos valores, é ser competente, responsável e inovador. É ter uma comunicação aberta e transparente.

A visão da Statkraft é renovar a forma como o mundo é movido. Para navegar essa jornada complexa, precisamos de todas as vozes à mesa. description:
Join to apply for the MÉDICO RADIOLOGISTA – HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS – Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde .

Sobre o Hospital

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais são distribuídos os serviços de emergência, Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal, maternidade, clínica médica, cirurgia‑geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio-X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo HMPII, há duas enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial, dispondo de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções graves em pacientes queimados. A Unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos e visa absorver demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para casos de risco iminente de morte ou necessidade de cirurgia urgente.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Realizar e interpretar exames, diagnosticar e tratar doenças, através da visualização de ossos, órgãos ou estruturas em exames radiológicos e de imagens em geral, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal da Saúde.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo
  • Título de Especialista em Radiologia

Descrição da vaga

Venha fazer parte de uma empresa que ama transformar com tecnologia e abraça a diversidade em todas as suas formas!

Requisitos e qualificações

1. Gestão de Projetos e Metodologias

  • Metodologias de Gerenciamento de Projetos*: Conhecimento aprofundado e experiência prática em metodologias como PMBOK (PMI), Agile (Scrum, Kanban) e/ou Waterfall.
  • Planejamento e Execução*: Habilidade em elaborar cronogramas, orçamentos, planos de recursos e planos de comunicação. Experiência na execução e acompanhamento de projetos, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e escopo.
  • Gestão de Riscos*: Capacidade de identificar, analisar e mitigar riscos em projetos de infraestrutura.
  • Gestão de Partes Interessadas (Stakeholders)*: Habilidade em gerenciar expectativas e comunicação com clientes, fornecedores e equipes internas.
  • Ferramentas de Gerenciamento de Projetos*: Proficiência em softwares como Microsoft Project, Jira, Asana, Trello ou equivalentes.

2. Infraestrutura de Rede Wi‑Fi

  • Conceitos de Redes Wireless*: Domínio de padrões Wi‑Fi (802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax), frequências (2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, 6 GHz), canais e tecnologias MIMO/MU‑MIMO.
  • Arquitetura e Projeto de Redes Wi‑Fi*: Experiência em levantamento de requisitos, design de topologias de rede, planejamento de cobertura (site surveys, heatmaps) e capacidade.
  • Implementação e Configuração*: Habilidade na instalação física e configuração lógica de Access Points (APs), Controladores Wireless (WLCs) e sistemas de gerenciamento de rede sem fio.
  • Otimização e Troubleshooting*: Capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver problemas de desempenho, conectividade e segurança em redes Wi‑Fi. Otimização de redes para alta densidade e performance.
  • Segurança de Redes Wireless*: Conhecimento em protocolos de segurança (WPA2/3, 802.1X, EAP), autenticação, criptografia e políticas de acesso (Guest Access, NAC).

3. Conhecimento Específico em Tecnologias Cisco

  • Equipamentos Cisco Wi‑Fi*: Experiência comprovada com Access Points Cisco (Catalyst, Aironet series), Controladores Wireless Cisco (Cisco Catalyst 9800 Series Wireless Controllers) e Cisco DNA Center.
  • Configuração e Gerenciamento Cisco*: Proficiência na configuração e gerenciamento de dispositivos Cisco via CLI, GUI e APIs.
  • Cisco Prime Infrastructure / DNA Center*: Familiaridade com as plataformas de gerenciamento de rede da Cisco para monitoramento, automação e provisionamento.
  • Certificações Cisco (Diferencial)*:
  • CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate) Enterprise*: Demonstra conhecimento fundamental em redes corporativas.
  • CCNP Enterprise (ou certificações equivalentes focadas em Wireless)*: Para um nível mais avançado de design e troubleshooting.

4. Conhecimentos Complementares de Rede

  • Fundamentos de Redes IP*: TCP/IP, VLANs, Roteamento (estático/dinâmico), Switching (Layer 2/Layer 3).
  • Serviços de Rede*: DNS, DHCP, RADIUS, NTP.
  • Monitoramento de Rede*: Utilização de ferramentas de monitoramento e análise de tráfego de rede (Wireshark, ferramentas de SNMP).
